Class LockLevel

java.lang.Object
org.roux.model.LockLevel
public final class LockLevel extends Object
The LockLevel type holds the integer stored on an operator lock. The EXCLUSIVE_WRITE level is 1. The READ_ONLY_SNAPSHOT level is 2. The DRAIN_AND_HALT level is 3. A caller passes one of these integers when it asks for a LockToken. The type refuses construction. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#LockLevel roux-design.md
